exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 210 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution), not just today's window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 210 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A few contacts carry more than one lead: tag or duplicate opportunities across pipelines, so tag counts don't sum exactly to 210 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the same 119-opportunity bulk-import batch (frozen since the Oct 2025 pipeline launch) and Zinat Hirji's 260.9-day Postponed record, flagged in workflow_drift.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (open 183+27+51, won 1+302+6, lost 116+111+7, abandoned 1060+229+2). Continues the documented ~297+ won / ~1,132+ abandoned scale, growing steadily run over run since 08-14.
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 51 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (66 total, lifetime). Retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds defined for this pipeline (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence). Data-quality note: 13 of the 51 'open' records sit in the '6a. Closed - Won' STAGE and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost' STAGE while their opportunity status field still reads 'open' — stage placement and status aren't kept in sync in this pipeline (see stragglers_ranked).

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.note: Only 2 of 24 Meeting-Scheduled contacts had a verifiable appointment date this run (via today's/recent active conversations: Virdee Jasvir — 0.17d to appointment, 29.8d effective window; Hossein Zamanpour — 0.82d to appointment, 29.2d effective window — both healthy). Same data-access limitation as 08-08/08-14: a full per-contact appointment sweep across all 24 is needed for a reliable trend metric. See platforms/GHL.md for the broader 2026-07-25 finding (52-contact sample, 26.3-day median effective window).

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to today's 27 active conversations plus the 4 new leads; every hot/warm mobile-quote-tagged contact checked had automated nurture firing on schedule (2-day, 5-day, 8-9-day touches all observed) — no violations found. A full account-wide sweep of all mobile-quote-tagged contacts was not attempted this run (same scoping limitation as 08-08/08-14).
reporting.categorization_miss_check_note: Scoped to today's 27 active conversations. No genuine categorization misses found this run (Ian Hoang and Muhammad Rafiq had two-way or automated contact but are both <24h old, too early to call a miss) — contrast with 08-14 which found 3.

drift_findings_breakdown._comment: metrics.drift_findings is the sum of underlying affected records per category (post-exclusion), not the count of report lines in workflow_drift (which aggregates large groups into single lines for readability). A record can appear in more than one category.

reporting.ingest_gap_note: The last successful ghl-ingest run before this one was 2026-08-14 — a 15-day gap (2026-08-15 through 2026-08-29 were not ingested). Per instructions this run used the standard 24h window (2026-08-29T12:12 UTC to 2026-08-30T12:12 UTC) rather than backfilling the gap; activity from 08-15 through 08-28 is not reflected in this file's items/metrics, though some of it surfaces indirectly in opportunity days_in_stage, avg_days_in_stage, and the repeated 'same record flagged since 08-14' notes in workflow_drift above.
reporting.resolved_since_last_report: None of the specific items flagged as overdue in the 2026-08-14 report have been resolved: Zinat Hirji (abandonment overdue), Bash Saqr and Tina Tran (meeting_no_followup), and the ~119-opportunity Far Out (Cold) bulk batch are all still open and in the same state, 16 days later.
